findings: BLOCKER 1 - PH-251 spec/tasks whitelist mismatch plus stray text: the frozen PH-251 spec's executor whitelist omits `pmo_plugins/settlement/migrations/*.py`, while `project/tasks.json` includes it and the spec itself requires a new `ReceiptFeeSettlement` model plus 'settlement/costing 按实际叶节点下一号' migration; an implementer following the spec would be unable to add the required settlement migration, and the tasks contract allows a path the spec does not. The same spec's integrator root_only line also contains leftover uncertain text: '`project/specs/PH-244.md`?（不，不改）'. Fix: make the PH-251 spec whitelist exactly match the frozen tasks allowed_paths (at minimum add `pmo_plugins/settlement/migrations/*.py`; either add the costing migration path consistently or state no costing schema migration is needed), remove the stray '?（不，不改）' text, and keep root_only paths listed as integrator-only.

BLOCKER 2 - PH-253 conflicts with the ready PH-250 fee-approval slice: PH-253 requires verify_integrity to assert 'status 仅 draft（PH-244 冻结范围）' and '无会计事件/SourceConsumption/成本/未清写入'. PH-250 is registered ready in this same PR and will legitimately write approved/rejected BankCharge statuses and, on approval, one cost AccountingEvent + one cost LedgerPosting + a cost SourceConsumption claim for the BankCharge. If PH-253 is implemented after PH-250 (both are ready; no ordering is enforced), the hardened verifier would flag PH-250's valid facts as corruption, repeating the cross-slice false-positive class found in PH-240. Fix: either (a) explicitly constrain PH-253 to land before PH-250 and record that ordering (and state the overlap must be revisited), or (b) make its status assertion accept the canonical five-state enum and allow the PH-250 cost event/claim/posting for approved charges while still enforcing one saved event per version and no duplicate/legacy-draft corruption; add a boundary regression for an approved BankCharge with cost facts. Align the text with PH-250's spec.

NOTE - evidence/whitelist wording accuracy: (a) report deviation #3 says 'PH-252 whitelist uses the pmo_plugins/invoicing/* prefix', but the frozen tasks allowed_paths and the spec actually enumerate per-file paths (the spec uses shorthand `services.py`, `views.py`, etc. after the first full path); (b) the report's verify-change evidence says 'all 13 changed files' while `git diff 0721ad4..HEAD` contains exactly 12 files; (c) PH-247's own frozen spec still says it promotes PH-239 while the two PH-243 spec sentences were correctly changed to say PH-243 did the promotion (disclosed in deviations as historical text, acceptable, but the report/evidence counts should be corrected in the final evidence commit); (d) PH-250 spec says approval-chain fields (submitted_by/approved_by/reject_reason) are already in PH-244's model - they are NOT (BankCharge has only status/version/created_by); PH-250 correctly includes costing/migrations in its whitelist and can add them, but the spec wording should be corrected to say they must be added by migration.
